item.title: Raspberry Pi's New AI Hat Adds 8GB of RAM for Local LLMs
item.description:
📝 With that, the Hailo 10H is capable of running LLMs entirely standalone, freeing the Pi's CPU and system RAM for other tasks. It's honestly crazy how many small tasks you can do even with free local models.
